title: Repeated Word Finder
description: Find words you overuse — full frequency table plus accidental double-words like "the the" — and tighten your writing.
howto: Paste your text into the box.
See every repeated word ranked by frequency, with counts and share of total words.
Accidental double-words ("the the", "and and") are flagged separately at the top.

faqs.a: Any word appearing 2 or more times (case-insensitive). Common stop-words like "the" and "and" are included — the table helps you spot surprising overuse.
The same word typed twice in a row, e.g. "the the". These are almost always typos, so they are flagged separately.
Yes — "The" and "the" count as the same word in the frequency table.
